[b][size=4]The Problem[/size]
[/b]
Does your game freeze for a split second (or longer) every time you press [b]E[/b] to open your inventory?

Stardew Valley normally loads [i]every single menu tab[/i] the moment you open the menu. It loads your entire friends list, every crafting recipe, and your collections all at once, even if you just wanted to check your inventory.

If you use large content mods (like Stardew Valley Expanded or Ridgeview) or have many custom recipes, this causes a noticeable lag spike every time you open the menu.

[b][size=4]The Solution[/size]
[/b]
This mod eliminates that lag by using [b]"Lazy Loading."
[/b]
Instead of loading everything at once, this mod tells the game to wait. It will only load the heavy tabs (like Social or Crafting) when you actually [b]click[/b] on them.

The result? The menu opens [b]instantly[/b].

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41564/41564-1769189601-1536619337.png[/img]

[b][size=4]Features[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Zero Lag:[/b] Pressing E is snappy and responsive again, even with 100+ mods installed.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]On-Demand Loading:[/b] Heavy pages are only generated the moment you need them.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Full 1.6 Support:[/b] Works with all standard menu tabs, including the new Animals and Powers tabs.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Failsafe Protection:[/b] If you use a hotkey to jump directly to a tab (like pressing 'C' for Social), the mod detects this and loads the page immediately so you never see a blank screen.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41564/41564-1769141650-1854473204.png[/img]﻿[b][size=4]


Supported Tabs[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]Skills (Tab 1)[/*]
[*]Social (Tab 2)[/*]
[*]Crafting & Cooking (Tab 4)[/*]
[*]Animals (Tab 5)[/*]
[*]Special Items & Powers (Tab 6)[/*]
[*]Collections (Tab 7)[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Configuration[/size]
[/b]
This mod is fully integrated with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
You can toggle "Lazy Loading" on or off for specific tabs. If you use another mod that drastically changes a specific tab (like the Social page) and it conflicts, simply turn off the optimization for that specific tab in the settings.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/*]
[*]Works alongside most UI mods.[/*]
[*]If you use a mod that auto-scans pages immediately upon opening the menu (like some "Social Sorter" mods), the optimization for that specific tab may be bypassed automatically. This is normal behavior to prevent crashes.[/*]
[/list]
